t: What he said one evening after the night prayer
a: أَرَأَيْتُمْ لَيْلَتَكُمْ هَذِهِ فَإِنَّ رَأْسَ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ مِنْهَا لاَ يَبْقَى مِمَّنْ هُوَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ أَحَدٌ
p: A-raʾaytum laylatakum hādhih, fa-inna raʾsa miʾati sanatin minhā lā yabqā mimman huwa ʿalā ẓahri-l-arḍi aḥad
m: Do you see this night of yours? At the end of a hundred years from it, no one now on the face of the earth will be left.
